observation: Two unique completed GUT contamination-triage receipts scoped to the same contested parent, carrying the same supported triage classification but different canonical provenance, are currently placed on HOLD because dynamic decomposition treats classification+provenance as one conflict signature.
qualityRisk: Distinct provenance is evidence-significant and must remain visible, but provenance diversity alone does not imply classification disagreement. Treating it as a conflict can block an otherwise identical bounded decomposition profile and makes downstream behavior depend on provenance identity rather than on the metabolic diagnosis that is supposed to regulate VAJRA.
requiredFix: Separate classification agreement from provenance identity. Multiple unique qualifying receipts may select one bounded profile only when all supported classifications agree; all distinct provenance must remain auditable and must not be claimed independent merely because canonical strings differ. Any classification disagreement must continue to HOLD with no facets.
promotionGate: same classification + distinct canonical provenance => same bounded profile
classification disagreement => HOLD with zero facets
replays do not inflate receipt counts
cross-organ GUT and VAJRA regressions pass
privacy: Synthetic de-identified evidence only; no private connector content, names, IDs, or URLs are stored.
